info.title: CED OPS API
info.description: REST API for the CED (Continuous Electro-Deposition) Operations management system. Configuration-driven report engine over a module hierarchy (module types, modules, template versions, processes, process parameters and global parameters), report sessions and completed reports, plus dashboard, unified search, analytics and role-based access control.
